svg.aria-label: The theoretical stress–strain loop encloses approximately 50.27 J/m³ dissipated per cycle; use dimensionless strain when calculating its area. Residuals of the noisy fit are arranged by phase on the right. Shading spans twice the prescribed noise standard deviation.
